name: Science Fiction: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Science Fiction look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, science fiction concept art, functional industrial design with panel lines and wear, believable scale cues, alien forms with consistent biology, cool blue and teal palette with warm indicator lights, hard rim light, atmospheric haze and depth
negative_prompt: medieval, fantasy magic, rustic wood, cartoon, clean toy-like surfaces, text, watermark
